freshResearch.officialViewerInspection: The official Guigang Natural Resources Bureau homepage request timed out after 20 seconds in this environment. The first-party registration pages were available through search/open results and describe query procedures and required parcel-map materials, but expose no current JavaScript viewer, public map API, CRS/schema, safe native parcel ID, or bounded geometry response. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, credential, private token, or unsafe owner/address/titleholder field was used.
